name: SQS
about: Sales Quality Score: behaviours scored 1 to 5 from the conversation. Edit names, descriptions and weights to match your own SQS. A behaviour the conversation gave no chance to show is left unscored.

behaviors.name: Opening and rapport
behaviors.description: Greets warmly, uses the customer's name, sets a clear purpose for the call.

behaviors.name: Discovery
behaviors.description: Asks open questions to learn the customer's situation and needs before pitching.

behaviors.name: Active listening
behaviors.description: Reflects back what the customer said and builds on it; does not repeat questions already answered.

behaviors.name: Empathy
behaviors.description: Acknowledges feelings and concerns before moving to a solution.

behaviors.name: Product accuracy and honesty
behaviors.description: States only what the product facts support. No invented features, prices or promises.

behaviors.name: Value framing
behaviors.description: Links product benefits to this customer's stated needs, not a generic feature list.

behaviors.name: Objection handling
behaviors.description: Acknowledges the objection, explores it, answers with facts, checks it is resolved.

behaviors.name: Clear next step
behaviors.description: Ends with a specific, agreed next step without pressure.

behaviors.name: Clarity and brevity
behaviors.description: Short, plain sentences. No jargon, no rambling.
